articles.title: UN Report Says U.S. Climate Pollution Went Up
articles.summary: A UN report says U.S. climate pollution went up a lot last year. The U.S. government disagrees.

articles.title: Boeing's Biggest 737 Max Jet Gets Approved to Fly Passengers
articles.summary: The FAA approved Boeing's 737 Max 10, its biggest 737 Max jet, to carry passengers after almost ten years.

articles.title: Company Sues Over Trump's Taxes on Canadian Goods
articles.summary: An American food company has sued over Trump's 50% tariffs on Canadian goods, saying he used an old law wrongly.
